name: Tadhg the Currach Rower

intro.text: A currach is tar and canvas over a frame of laths. Light as a leaf, tough as an old boot. Like me. Come on!

win: You've the shoulders of a rower, so you have. Or the luck of one.
after: We race the currachs at the regattas in summer. Three to a boat, and three opinions on how to steer.
